evidence.observation: Reboiler temperature reads 373.963 °C, markedly above the other column temperatures.
Temperature has risen monotonically to 381.539 °C without a corresponding rise in other column temperatures; sensor bias/drift or actual localized overheating requires discrimination.
Readings remain near their initial values: 75.794, 70.978 and 58.174 °C, and 398.619 mbar; no corroborating system-wide thermal or pressure rise.
Reflux and distillate flows are 0.114 and 0.562 L/h; their quotient is approximately 0.203, inconsistent with FYI702=3.559 if it represents the simultaneous reflux/distillate ratio.

args.missing_evidence: Independent reboiler temperature and T701 calibration/units verification to distinguish sensor error from real overheating; operating temperature limits and heater settings; FYI702 definition and flow setpoints; product composition and separation target.
